[b][Change Log][/b]
Version 1.0.1-Alpha

[b]Features[/b]:
[list]
[*]Now you can browse games without opening the website
[*]Now if you leave your hosted farm, it will be removed from the list immediately.
[/list]
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This mod will help you find other players so you can play together by publishing your server to a server list.

Your hosted farm will be visible on the multiplayer hub farms browser.


[Optional]
Your hosted game will be available on my list at the link below:
[url=https://stardewvalleylobby.000webhostapp.com/]https://stardewvalleylobby.000webhostapp.com/[/url]
[b]*You can disable listing in mod configuration file.

Features[/b]:
[list]
[*]List your server on internet and let players play with you
[*]Filter Players mod and Kick/Ban unwanted mods
[*]Allow only modded clients to connect to your game.
[/list]
[b]FAQ:[/b]
Works with unlimited players mod?  
- Yes!

This mod runs on android?
- No!

[b]Usage:
[/b]Just install this mod and everytime that you host a game it will be available to others through the web portal :D

[b]Configuration[/b]:
[code]﻿{
  "EnableMultiplerHub": true, -- Enable to list your hosted game
  "AllowOnlyModdedClients": true, -- Allow only modded players
  "EnableModBlacklist": true, -- Allow mod blacklist, this will perform the actions below
  "ServerMOTD": "Change this awesome server motd", -- Message to display for who will join your farm. 
  "DisallowedMods": {
    "Dummy.Mod": { -- Mod Unique ID
      "DisplayName": "Dummy Mod", -- Mod Display Name
      "Version": "1.0.0", - Mod Version
      "AutoKickPlayer": false, -- Set true to auto kick players
      "AutoBanPlayer": false, -- Set true to auto ban players
      "NotifyMasterPlayer": false -- Set true to receive notifications when someone connect with disallowd mod
    }
  }
}
[/code]
[b]Known issues:
[list]
[*]If your hosted game isn't listed, use ipconfig /flushdns on Windows Console (CMD)
[*]The browser menu get displaced when you resize your game window
[/list][/b]
